list: Official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18 (PSNProfiles / Exophase, as shipped in the kit)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: finish the roadmap, then the 100% completion cleanup, and this is the last trophy you earn.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order; the platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.
Leave it to the end of the roadmap: story first, then activities and collectibles, then the 100% completion cleanup.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy from the opening mission. It unlocks naturally and cannot be missed.

steps.t: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.
Unmissable: it pops as part of the story, so just keep playing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Unmissable.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission.
Before Chapter 1 ends, do the one-time balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see its guide) and keep a Chapter 1 save.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Unmissable.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 2 to its final mission.
Unmissable: chapter-end trophies pop as the story advances.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Unmissable.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 3 to its final mission.
Unmissable: chapter-end trophies pop as the story advances.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Unmissable.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 4 to its final mission.
Unmissable: chapter-end trophies pop as the story advances.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for the final mission. After the credits you keep free roam of Leonida, so nothing after this point is locked away.

steps.t: Finish the final story mission.
After the credits, free roam continues and the 100% completion checklist unlocks for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable.

steps.t: Play the mission Breakfast Run to the end.
Unmissable: mission trophies pop as the story advances.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable.

steps.t: Play the mission The Cartel Heist to the end.
Unmissable: mission trophies pop as the story advances.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. Unmissable.

steps.t: Play the mission Child's Play to the end.
Unmissable: mission trophies pop as the story advances.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. Unmissable.

steps.t: Play the mission Headliners to the end.
Unmissable: mission trophies pop as the story advances.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable.

steps.t: Play the mission VCIA Takedown to the end.
Unmissable: mission trophies pop as the story advances.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable.

steps.t: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to the end.
Unmissable: mission trophies pop as the story advances.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold for 100% completion. The checklist appears after the story under Progress. You do not need literally everything: 15 of the 18 card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges count toward 100%, so plan the cleanup around the checklist, not around doing all of everything.

steps.t: Finish the story first; the 100% completion checklist then appears under Progress.
Work the checklist, not the whole map: 15 of 18 card sets and 70 of 80 challenges are enough for 100%.
Track progress at any time under Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion.
Expect the long grind: guides put the platinum at roughly 200-300 hours in total.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: stunt jumps (130), under-bridge flights (202), knife flights (40) and base jumps (25). A little over half the total is enough, so pick the easiest types first.

steps.t: Do any 250 stunts; the game holds 397, so you need just over half.
Start with stunt jumps and under-bridge flights, the two biggest pools (130 and 202).
Find stunt spots on the map under Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Track progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish anything.

steps.t: Try all 9 activity types once each.
Sample them as you meet them during the story; the shooting range, fishing, racing and drone races all count.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some unlock only after other conditions are met.

steps.t: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges across both ranges.
Ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero).
Find them under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges; some challenges stay locked until their conditions are met.
Track progress under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some races charge an entry fee, so bring cash.

steps.t: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Some locations charge an entry fee; carry cash before you travel to them.
Find locations under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not count, so keep moving to new race locations.

steps.t: Win 20 different races; wins on the same race do not stack.
Track every race location under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.
Most locations let you hire a car; watch its Rating, which mod shops can improve.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Early on Cal asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2kg; fish the marked area until you land one big enough.

steps.t: Take Cal's request to catch a parrotfish over 2kg.
Fish in the marked area until you catch one over 2kg.
You need a boat with a fishing rod; boats in the area can be taken if you have none.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Any arcade game counts; pick the shortest one you enjoy.

steps.t: Find an arcade and complete one arcade game to its end.
One completion is enough; no score target is named.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Andy's missions, ending with his final one. Stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.

steps.t: Complete every mission in Andy's strand, through his final mission.
Stranger missions can be finished after the story in free roam.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Kenton's missions, ending with Maritime Disputes.

steps.t: Complete Kenton's missions through the one named Maritime Disputes.
Stranger missions can be finished after the story in free roam.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Billy's missions, ending with Hometown Heroes.

steps.t: Complete Billy's missions through the one named Hometown Heroes.
Stranger missions can be finished after the story in free roam.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The five named character finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward the 8; find three more stranger strands in the open world.

steps.t: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida.
The five character-final strands count toward the 8; add three more stranger strands.
Stranger missions stay available in free roam after the story.
Watch: TechWiser, reported via eGamers and games.gg, says the five stranger chains have windows tied to story progress — do each strand as it appears rather than leaving all of them to post-game.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Randy's missions. His strand involves vehicle wish-list deliveries, so check the in-game list as you go.

steps.t: Complete every mission in Randy's strand, through his final mission.
Randy's strand includes wish-list vehicle deliveries; use the in-game list to find them.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Tyrone's missions. His strand involves Kitty Litter Lab locations, which the guides list.

steps.t: Complete every mission in Tyrone's strand, through his final mission.
Tyrone's strand uses Kitty Litter Lab locations; the linked location lists cover them.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the game's only one. Meditate at all 18 spots. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia may disappear after Chapter 1, and sources disagree on whether the trophy needs it, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save. Each spot counts once per character, so meditate with both Jason and Lucia where the spot allows; the last spot, Ascent Mountain on Mount Kalaga, appears only once both characters play together after Coffee Break.

steps.t: FIRST, in Chapter 1: the morning after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house on Key Lento, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
Keep a manual Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops; the balcony meditation is gone after Chapter 1.
Meditate at the other 17 marked spots; a meditation counts only after the final zen animation plays.
Spots count once per character, so bring your partner and meditate with both where possible.
Save Ascent Mountain (Mount Kalaga peak) for last: it appears only once both characters play together, after Coffee Break.
Track progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
Honest note: PowerPyx and GTABase flag this as possibly missable; PushSquare lists the 18 spots with no missable warning. Both versions are shown here; the safe move is the same either way.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Hunting is one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.

steps.t: Take Bret's hunting request and follow the marked animal.
Hunt the unique animal Bret names; a regular animal does not count.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward progress. Going for 100% completion needs 15 sets, so this pops on the way.

steps.t: Collect every card in any 3 of the 18 sets.
Track progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Selling cards at pawn shops does not remove their progress.
For 100% completion you need 15 sets, so keep collecting past this trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app: landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags make up the pool. Hold Up to open the app on either character's phone.

steps.t: Open WAiNK on either character's phone (hold Up) and scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags.
The named pools hold 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags.
Track progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 in-game challenges. 100% completion needs 70, so this pops on the way to the gold.

steps.t: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
View all challenges and their requirements under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges.
For 100% completion you need 70 challenges, so keep going past this trophy.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and lose it. Do it away from the story missions so a fail costs nothing.

steps.t: Bring your partner, then build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears with your partner still with you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level ever dropping. Pick three shops close together and keep moving.

steps.t: Bring your partner and rob a shop to raise a wanted level.
Rob two more shops back-to-back before the wanted level clears.
If the wanted level drops, start the chain again from the first shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting inside one or scanning one with WAiNK both count, and it comes naturally during the story.

steps.t: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting in them or scanning them.
Track what you have found under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles.
It comes naturally through the story; mop up rare vehicles in free roam.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group of enemies bunched together and trigger it when all five are in view.

steps.t: Find a group of at least 5 enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends.
If you run out of targets, retry: the count resets each use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The description points at Vice City International Airport: leave by an unscheduled route, in the spirit of a getaway rather than a booked flight. No guide had a confirmed step-by-step method as of 20 Nov 2026, so treat any specific route you read elsewhere as unverified until players confirm it.

steps.t: Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and make an unscheduled departure, e.g. taking off without following the normal departure.
Method unconfirmed as of 20 Nov 2026: no published guide had a verified step-by-step for this trophy.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The description is a joke about Rhino tanks: it points at doing something with a Rhino tank. No guide had a confirmed method as of 20 Nov 2026; do not trust a specific invented step until players confirm it.

steps.t: Get a Rhino tank and use it in the way the trophy's joke implies.
Method unconfirmed as of 20 Nov 2026: no published guide had a verified step-by-step for this trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards' sightlines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob it without being detected: stay out of sightlines and leave before the alarm.
If you are spotted, the attempt fails; leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are bigger jobs than shop robberies: plan the escape route before you go in.

steps.t: Rob a bank vault and escape; repeat for 5 vaults in total.
Plan the getaway before entering: the escape counts, not just the robbery.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. A nod to the classic GTA V heist setup: stop the truck, take the cash, and lose the wanted level.

steps.t: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Take the cash and escape; lose the wanted level to finish the job.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida. Visit all regions and let the map fill in; it comes naturally if you travel for the other trophies.

steps.t: Travel to every region of Leonida until the map is fully explored.
Combine it with the other travel trophies: WAiNK scans, stunts and races all push you across the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for every gang in Leonida. Find each gang's operations while exploring, and tick them off one gang at a time.

steps.t: Find and rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang.
Work gang by gang so none is missed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The description is literal: have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach. No guide had a confirmed exact spot as of 20 Nov 2026; the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach are the place to try.

steps.t: Go to Ocean Beach and order a cocktail at a beachfront spot with a view.
Exact spot unconfirmed as of 20 Nov 2026: no published guide had a verified location for this trophy.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The description points at driving a car out through a vehicle showroom's front, in classic GTA style. No guide had a confirmed exact showroom or method as of 20 Nov 2026.

steps.t: Take a vehicle inside a showroom and smash your way out through the front.
Exact showroom unconfirmed as of 20 Nov 2026: no published guide had a verified method for this trophy.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, following through on the activity. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types.

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game of bowling through to the end.
This also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The description hints at a partnership achievement with broad appeal, but no guide had a confirmed method as of 20 Nov 2026. Do not trust a specific invented step until players confirm it.

steps.t: Build your partnership's standing until this trophy pops; the exact trigger is not yet confirmed.
Method unconfirmed as of 20 Nov 2026: no published guide had a verified step-by-step for this trophy.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The description points at making choices that affect your Criminal Profile. GameMapa's cross-check notes 500 profile-affecting actions for this trophy, but that figure is single-source and unconfirmed; treat it as a lead, not a fact.

steps.t: Make choices that affect your Criminal Profile as you play.
One list reports 500 profile-affecting actions, but that number is unconfirmed and single-source.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something that failed the first time. No guide had a confirmed method as of 20 Nov 2026.

steps.t: Retry something you failed once; the trophy's joke is that the second try is the charm.
Method unconfirmed as of 20 Nov 2026: no published guide had a verified step-by-step for this trophy.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The description suggests a strange, unexplained event. No guide had a confirmed method as of 20 Nov 2026; this is one of the five hidden trophies still unsolved in the published lists.

steps.t: Look for a strange, unexplained event in the open world.
Method unconfirmed as of 20 Nov 2026: published lists still mark this trophy unsolved.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The description asks for a melee drive-by that bowls targets over. No guide had a confirmed exact method as of 20 Nov 2026; the bowling connection suggests doing it near the bowling alley area, but that is a guess, not a confirmed step.

steps.t: Perform a melee drive-by that knocks targets over like tenpins.
Method unconfirmed as of 20 Nov 2026: published lists still mark this trophy unsolved.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; launder them steadily rather than in one go.

steps.t: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts until the $250,000 total is reached.
Track the running total as you launder; it is cumulative across the whole game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. It is cumulative, so it comes naturally if you buy vehicles, clothes, weapons and upgrades through the game.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops; the total is cumulative.
Big purchases help most: vehicles, upgrades and property-adjacent spending all count.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties. Save up and buy them as they appear on the market; garages also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.

steps.t: Purchase all 8 garage properties.
Buy them as they appear; they also store vehicles for the On the Spot trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Discover vehicles first (Whip It Good), then register the ones you want to keep.

steps.t: Discover vehicles in the world, then register 10 of them in the Scooter Bros app.
Garage properties from Little Boxes give you somewhere to keep them.
